posts.title: Why I actually like TPMs
posts.description: I think Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs) are a huge net positive to most computer users . Maybe this is a hot take. This goes against the position of many computer security researchers and enthusiasts. For example, Microsoft’s TPM 2.0 requirement to run Windows 11 received a huge amount of community blowback.
